data.name: Kuraiman
data.gender_notes: Kuraiman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'kara' which means 'to help'. This name signifies a person who is always ready to lend a helping hand. The name Kuraiman carries the meaning “Little helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kuraiman usually hope their child will grow to embody little helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing selflessness and kindness.
data.etymology: Kuraiman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kuraiman total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: قريمان
in_arabic.meaning: المرحوم، الموقر، الممتاز، الإشراف، الرؤية، الإدراك، التمييز
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم قريمان مشتق من قري، وهو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى في القرآن الكريم، والمعنى هو المرحوم، الموقر، الممتاز، الإشراف، الرؤية، الإدراك، التمييز، وهذا الاسم له أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام، حيث أن المرحومين أهل السعادة، والموقرون أهل الأمانة، والممتازون أهل النجاح، والإشراف على الخلق هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، والرؤية هي من صفات الله تعالى، والإدراك والتمييز هما من أهم صفات الإنسان المثالي

in_urdu.name: قریمان
in_urdu.meaning: مرحوم، موقر، ممتاز، اشراف، رؤیا، ادریاک، تمییز
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام قریمان اصلاقرئی سے ماخوذ ہے اور یہ نام بھی قرآن کریم میں سے ایک لطیف نام ہے جس کے معنی ہیں مرحوم، موقر، ممتاز، اشراف، رؤیا، ادریاک، تمییز، اس لیے اس نام سے مسلمان والدین اپنے بچوں کے نام رکھتے ہیں کہ وہ اپنے والدین کی یاد میں رہیں اور ان کی طرح موقر اور ممتاز ہوں، اور ان کے پاس اشراف کا خزانہ ہو، اور وہ دنیا اور آخرت دونوں میں رؤیا کریں

in_english.name: Kuraiman
in_english.meaning: Venerable, distinguished, outstanding, surveillance, insight, perception, discernment
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kuraiman is derived from the Arabic root قري, which is one of the beautiful names of Allah in the Quran. The meaning of the name is venerable, distinguished, outstanding, surveillance, insight, perception, and discernment. This name has great importance in Islam, as the venerable ones are the people of happiness, the distinguished ones are the people of integrity, and the outstanding ones are the people of success. Surveillance over creation is one of the beautiful names of Allah, and insight is one of the attributes of Allah, while perception and discernment are two of the most important attributes of the ideal human being.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kuraiman" holds a significant cultural impact in many Muslim communities, as it represents the values of kindness, generosity, and support. The name's origin from the Arabic language 'kara' which means 'to help' is a powerful reminder of the importance of helping others and contributing to the betterment of society. Kuraiman is often seen as a supportive and caring figure, and his or her actions inspire those around them to do the same.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Kuraiman" holds great significance in the Islamic tradition. It is a reminder of Allah's mercy and compassion towards humanity. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Allah's mercy is greater than His anger," highlighting Allah's infinite mercy and love for His creation. By embodying the qualities of kindness and generosity, Kuraiman is striving to emulate this divine attribute and draw closer to Allah, as the Prophet (peace be upon him) said, "The most beloved of actions to Allah are those that are continual and regular, even if they are little." (Bukhari and Muslim) Thus, the name "Kuraiman" makes a profound call for individuals to be kind, generous, and compassionate to others, while ultimately striving to connect with their Creator through such actions.
